Preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 and confused about which books to read?

In this video, we provide a complete UPSC 2027 booklist for Prelims + Mains, covering History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Environment, Science & Technology, Ethics, Internal Security, CSAT, Essay and Current Affairs.

The biggest mistake UPSC aspirants make is collecting too many books. The objective of this booklist is to help you build a limited-source, maximum-revision strategy.

From NCERTs to standard reference books, PYQs and current affairs sources, this video explains what to read, what to skip and how to combine different sources effectively.
